description: This is a Java source file for an integration test class named AuthenticationIntegrationTest. The class contains test cases to verify authentication behavior (access control) for loan approval operations in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods to initialize REST client specifications with/without authentication and tests for authorized and unauthorized access scenarios.

classes.name: AuthenticationIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for verifying authentication behaviors for loan approval operations within the Apache Fineract system. It tests scenarios for both authenticated and unauthenticated access.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST client specifications and sets up the test environment including creating test users, accounts, and a sample loan application.

methods.name: shouldAllowAccessForAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Tests that an authenticated user is granted access to approve a loan application by expecting a 200 status code.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedForUnauthenticatedAccess
methods.description: Tests that an unauthenticated request to approve a loan returns a 401 Unauthorized response.

methods.name: setupLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create and configure a new loan product for testing.

methods.name: setupAuthenticatedRequestSpec
methods.description: Configures the request specification with Basic Authentication header.

methods.name: setupUnauthenticatedRequestSpec
methods.description: Configures the request specification without authentication headers.

methods.name: createLoanApprovalRequest
methods.description: Generates JSON payload for loan approval request.

methods.name: createLoanApprovalCommand
methods.description: Generates URL for loan approval operation.
